g.text: Mass balance of the pineapple biorefinery
Optimal design of version 12 · Chocó 2022 · 1,276 t/year of fruit processed. The width of each stream is proportional to its mass (t/year); liquids are converted to mass with their densities.
Outputs: wine 371 + vinegar 3,030 + flour 40 + vapour and CO₂ 539 + boiler 0 + compost 394 + field 899 = 5,273
Saleable products: 66 % of the mass entering; the fruit leaves 31 % as solid residue.
Pulp press: 87 % juice (Quesada Salas 2013); centrifuge: 12 % sludge; lees MF recovers 60 % of the juice.
Winery: CO₂ and lees by difference between must and wine; peel juice with 104 g/kg of sugar.
Acetification: 46 g ethanol + 32 g O₂ → 60 g acid; 5 % vinegar; dilution water closes the balance.
Crown to the boiler (combustion not detailed); leaves: 76 % juice and 18 % pulp (Liao et al. 2026), juice with 21.8 kg of ethanol per t.
